Oneliner

Investigate attitude control with strain-actuated deployable panels plus active thermal system.
Description

Investigate three navigation and control technology demonstrations utilizing strain-actuated deployable panels, an active thermal system for small spacecraft, and single-photon avalanche detectors.

Results

CAPSat, however, lost its functionality after launch, in-orbit laser annealing therefore could not be implemented.
